name: issue-flow
description: From the request to the merge request, by way of an issue that holds the plan and the roadmap that carries it out; for big developments, a project roadmap split into issues run in sequence; and, before anything else, a proposal of next steps read from the project's documentation. Works on GitLab (glab) and GitHub (gh).

default_branch.title: Target branch
default_branch.description: The branch that MRs/PRs are merged into. Leave empty to derive it from the repo with git symbolic-ref.

branch_prefix.title: Prefix of working branches
branch_prefix.description: The branch of an issue is named <prefix><issue number>.

verify_commands.title: Verification commands
verify_commands.description: The commands that must pass before a phase is closed, one per line (e.g. npm test, npm run lint). Empty: they are derived from the project.

docs_paths.title: Documentation to keep in sync
docs_paths.description: The documentation files or folders that the closing phase must re-read, one per line (e.g. README.md, docs/).

figma_file.title: Project Figma file
figma_file.description: The id of the Figma file to align before the code. Empty: no Figma phase in the roadmaps.
